findings_qualitative.value: Quasar hosts show smooth velocity gradients consistent with rotation-dominated outer gas, even in FIR-bright systems.

evidence.quote: we cautiously conclude that the outer parts of the [C II ]-emitting regions in all sources are dominated by rotation, with v/σ v > 1.

claims.hypothesis: Are major mergers common among hosts of fast-growing z~4.8 SMBHs?
claims.experiment: ALMA band-7 continuum and [C II] mapping of six quasars; companion search and mass comparison
claims.result: Three of six quasars have [C II]-confirmed companions at 14-45 kpc with |dv|<450 km/s and comparable M_dyn
claims.finding: A significant fraction (50% of the small sample) are interacting major mergers

evidence.loc: 3.4 Major mergers among hosts of fast-growing SMBHs
evidence.quote: 50% in our small sample – are interacting with companion galaxies of comparable mass

claims.hypothesis: Are mergers the only driver of fast SMBH growth?
claims.experiment: Companion occurrence by FIR-bright/faint class and kinematics
claims.result: Two of three interacting systems are FIR-faint; FIR-bright systems without companions show rotation
claims.finding: Other processes may also fuel the SMBHs and star formation

evidence.quote: the fact that not all high-SFR quasar hosts are accompanied by interacting SMGs and the gas kinematics as observed by ALMA suggest that other processes may be fueling these systems

claims.hypothesis: Is ALMA continuum consistent with Herschel-based SFRs?
claims.experiment: Gray-body and CE01 SEDs anchored to ALMA continuum, compared with Herschel

evidence.quote: We conclude that the new ALMA continuum measurements are broadly consistent with the Herschel -based ones

claims.hypothesis: Do the hosts follow the local BH-host mass ratio?
claims.result: Four of six have M_BH/M_dyn >~1/90, above the local ratio
claims.finding: Dynamical host masses are generally lower than expected from local ratios

evidence.quote: the [C II ]-based dynamical host masses are generally lower than what is expected from the locally observed BH-to-host mass ratio

why_this_data.value: Sub-mm interferometry probes hosts in a regime uncontaminated by AGN, with resolution to test mergers

evidence.quote: has enabled the direct observation of the hosts of high-redshift quasars in a spectral regime that is mostly uncontaminated by the AGN emission.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Hotter (65 K) and colder (40 K) gray-body SEDs tested; 65 K needed to match Herschel for J0331 but deemed beyond typical temperatures

evidence.quote: However, this high temperature is beyond what is typically observed, even among the most luminous FIR sources

limitations_admitted.value: M_dyn is uncertain: extended emission missed, inclination from marginally resolved sizes, beam smearing

evidence.quote: our ALMA data may not be able to detect the more extended lower surface brightness [C II ]-emitting regions, thus underestimating D [C II ]

evidence.loc: 3.4 Major mergers among hosts of fast-growing SMBHs
evidence.quote: The small size of our sample naturally limits the scope of our interpretation
